parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room reverse engineering task: infer Melody CLI behavior by normal interaction and produce an original executable without source lookup, wrapping, or binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent used native swarm mode and assigned 17 investigators to separate behavioral areas. Implementation remained with the parent after the research notes returned, not with a concurrent implementation owner.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote detailed notes under /workspace/notes for literals, raw strings, quantifiers, symbols, comments, CLI, test mode, and grammar edges. No integrated Rust or other replacement implementation was completed.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final packaged tree contained the original workspace plus notes and completion text, but no coherent new build system or deliverable replacement source.
parallel.verification: The children ran many black-box probes, but there was no whole-solution build, no integrated differential test of a new executable, and the official evaluator later failed at compile time.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Implementation, integration, packaging, and acceptance were left after the research swarm and did not reach a buildable submission before cancellation.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reverse engineering task and restriction set, including the need to avoid online source lookup and runtime wrapping.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single parent handled probing and implementation planning, identified /workspace as the target, and planned a standard-library Rust implementation because cached dependencies were unavailable.
serial.implementation: The serial actor performed extensive probing and wrote /tmp/probe/pty.py for experiments, but did not place a completed implementation in the deliverable workspace.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact preserved the original tree without generated implementation modules, so there was no final assembled solution for the evaluator to compile.
serial.verification: Verification was limited to probing the reference executable and environment checks; no implemented clone was compiled and tested end to end.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out during investigation and planning, leaving implementation pending and producing the same compile_failed official result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room executable-observation task and the prohibition on source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and recognized the same clean-room reverse-engineering constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the official outcome; both knew they needed a new original executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the work into a 17-agent research swarm covering many behavior areas before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept one actor as owner and planned a standard-library Rust implementation after establishing the workspace and dependency limits.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel allocated concurrency to investigation only; serial did not parallelize but had a direct implementation owner in the same thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children returned many note files as handoffs; the parent only started reading selected critical notes after all agents completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated findings in one context and checked dependency constraints directly without cross-agent interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's information crossed a child-to-parent notes boundary late; serial avoided that handoff but still over-investigated.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel generated research notes and was preparing to read error and grammar notes before building, with no integrated source produced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial explored the language and CLI, decided implementation would likely be std-only Rust, and wrote only a temporary probe script.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither produced the required implementation, but parallel delayed implementation behind the note phase while serial delayed it through single-thread probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The swarm completed and the parent received results, but result consumption began only at the end and was interrupted by cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its own investigation stream continued until cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed-result lifecycle bottleneck after the child swarm; serial's lifecycle failure was ordinary unfinished single-actor work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel's artifact included a notes directory and original files but lacked integrated replacement code; no live write collision caused the failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's artifact included the original tree without child notes and likewise lacked replacement implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The final artifact difference is research-note accumulation versus original-only preservation; neither shows a shared-state collision as the direct cause.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed reference probing through children but did not compile or accept an integrated clone before the official compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed reference probing but also did not compile or accept an integrated clone before the official compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed acceptance in the same way, so verification did not create an official outcome split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used a large first-phase swarm and reached cancellation immediately after beginning parent-side note consumption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but its budget went into sequential probing and planning rather than parallel handoff reduction.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the run budget, but the parallel-specific adverse boundary is deferred implementation after a completed investigation swarm.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Current completed official status records are not discordant: both modes failed with compile_failed and 0 of 1438 passing tests. The task-solving difference is process-level: parallel converted its concurrency into a research-note phase and left implementation until after result consumption, while serial performed the probing and implementation planning in one actor but also failed to deliver buildable source.
parallel_contributors: Seventeen-agent research swarm completed before implementation began.
Parent only started reading critical note files near cancellation.
Final artifact contained notes and original files rather than an integrated replacement codebase.
serial_contributors: Single actor identified a std-only Rust implementation path but continued probing.
No delegation occurred and no deliverable implementation was completed before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's failure is ordinary over-probing and unfinished implementation, not a coordination error.
Both official failures are compile failures from absent or non-buildable submissions.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a realized parallel adverse process pattern only

candidates.reason: The parent became the implementation owner after the investigation phase; the failure is deferred start, not absence of an implementer.
There were no separately completed implementation components needing integration ownership.
No directly promotable implementation or packageable component set existed for an assembly owner to package.
The missing end-to-end transition was downstream of the first-phase investigation plan, not a separate unowned pipeline.
There was no single mandatory serial preflight or harness gate; the issue was a broad completed investigation phase.
Investigators overlapped inside a 17-agent swarm, but implementation and integration were deferred until after the notes returned, leaving no buildable solution before cancellation.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel artifact remained a notes-heavy, non-buildable workspace because implementation and integration started too late after the research phase.
candidates.near_match_reason: The fan-out consumed budget, but the directly correctable boundary is phase ordering: child capacity was used for investigation before implementation.

candidates.reason: Implementation started late, but the specific evidenced cause is first-phase investigation rather than auxiliary work starving a concurrent implementation path.
The broad fan-out is real, but retaining it would duplicate the Serial Investigation chain rather than identify a distinct budget exhaustion episode.
No single child had an overbroad indispensable implementation assignment; children completed bounded research notes.
Children were assigned research topics and produced usable notes; no known requirement omission in a child brief made their work unusable.
No separately owned components were expected to interoperate, and no incompatible component interfaces were produced.
The child findings were present as note files; there is no evidence that known information was omitted or lost in transfer.
The note volume was large, but the stronger boundary is that all investigation was deferred as a first phase before implementation.
No parent action used a handoff describing a superseded workspace, dependency, or requirement state.
No incompatible child reports or contracts were both received and left unadjudicated at an integration decision point.
The parent never made an observable whole-task completion or acceptance decision; cancellation occurred before a submitted clone was claimed complete.
No replacement or retry episode repeated prior work without inherited findings or current workspace state.

candidates.reason: The parent received completed swarm results; the run cancellation stopped the parent, not an active child before needed results finalized.
No complete directly promotable implementation or compatible component set existed before closure.
No implementation change was merged after an integrated verification step, and no integrated verification occurred.
No child completed a delegated implementation that the parent failed to retrieve or adopt.
No verifier child produced a concrete finding that remained trapped below the parent before closure.
No required child failure or abort demanded takeover; the children completed their research assignments.
The parent did inspect the completed swarm result and began reading a note file, so the results were not simply ignored.
The parent was active after the swarm returned and began reading notes; it was not merely waiting blindly until timeout.
Children wrote separate research notes, not competing implementation files claiming overlapping behavior.
No two live agents edited the same source or configuration file with a reconciliation burden.
No agent replaced or deleted another agent's non-entry source module.
No live actor overwrote a required executable, entry point, or submitted deliverable owned by another actor.
No cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current outputs in the final workspace.
Multiple agents wrote notes in a shared workspace, but no unstable-state or provenance problem from unisolated implementation writes is shown.
No generated fixture, cache, helper, or temporary artifact from one actor was consumed by another as a stable reference environment.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent ran all 17 investigators as a separate first phase, received their notes, and only then began reading selected notes before cancellation, leaving no integrated implementation.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Implementation and integrated verification were postponed until after a completed research swarm, so the final parallel artifact remained non-buildable.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The fan-out breadth is downstream evidence, but the retained boundary is the serial research phase that delayed implementation.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Critical-Path Starvation, Late Finalization, Unused Completed Result, and Blind Timeout Wait were considered as same-chain symptoms and rejected.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no other independent parallel coordination consequence was retained.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only the first-phase investigation boundary was retained to avoid duplicating the same timeout and non-buildable-artifact chain.
